changelog: Major Search & Loading Speed Boost: fixed SQLite FTS5 join order (CROSS JOIN), added covering media_categories & partial composite indexes, instant 1-character title prefix search, exact-title relevance ranking, indexed library stats, 5-minute Home feed caching, race-free search cancellation, and 4s poster load timeout.

Search-Scoped Dynamic Filtering: when searching, the Filters panel (Sections, Year, Quality, Audio, Language, and Server) now automatically scopes to only matching results with live per-filter counts instead of showing all global categories.

Includes V1.3.0 features: YouTube-style left/right double-tap seeking (+10s/-10s), playback speed selector (0.25x-2x), in-app Download Manager with download icon button and Current Downloads progress/offline playback inside My List, and streamlined quality cards.
